body.title: drainTribulationOutcome returns true on empty director — no settle-ordering guard; settle/drain nil asymmetry
body.discoveredBy: reviewer-a + reviewer-b + reviewer-c (triple convergent independent discovery)
body.counterexample: call drainTribulationOutcome() before any settle/committed outcome: returns true via director.clear() on an empty director; settle throws (playerOwner guard) while drain vacuously succeeds — asymmetric nil handling
body.expected: drain reports 'committed outcome drained' and enforces settle-before-drain ordering as production checkTribulationOutcomeAction does
body.actual: returns true on an empty director — 'cleared-or-deferred' semantics; enables drain-before-settle order production cannot reach
body.rootCause: seam models clear() but not the committed-outcome precondition; nil-handling asymmetric with settle
body.repair: proposed: require committed outcome (or post-settle receipt) before clearing; align nil handling with settle
